At Capriole Coffee Service, we believe great coffee starts with great responsibility. Since 1975, we’ve been delivering exceptional coffee experiences to workplaces and the hospitality industry in the Netherlands and Belgium. As a family-owned business, nowadays part of the Miko Group, we combine decades of expertise with a personal approach. Roasting our own premium blends and offering tailored coffee solutions with outstanding service.

Sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Through our ‘Capriole Cares’ pillars: People, Planet, and Products, we invest in fair employment, reduce our carbon footprint, and offer a wide range of responsibly sourced coffee, tea, and equipment. From green energy to circular packaging, we’re committed to making every cup count. For our customers, for pope and the world around us.

Our Capriole Cares pillars - Care about People, Planet and Products - guide everything we do. We care about everyone involved in the coffee journey. From farmer to end consumer.
